problem_context.problem_statement: Replace the obsolete scalar force-write model with the same real CRTOS CircularAreaWrite implementation and verify only b_force!=0. Preserve all executable C tokens. The precondition consumes unified store_circular_area state and caller input bytes. Because the implementation truncates to free space and then unconditionally sets readidx=writeidx,status=1, a general underfilling force result cannot soundly be returned as store_circular_area. Define one clean idmanager-style raw-force state/resource that hides descriptor/layout witnesses and records the exact physical effect without claiming a valid FIFO. Also make recoverable full/fill-to-capacity cases expressible for later bridge proofs.
problem_context.expected_behavior: Null descriptor/input or zero request returns ERROR=1 preserving all owned resources. For b_force!=0 and valid inputs, actual=min(requested,capacity-current FIFO length); exact input prefix is copied into the ring, writeidx advances by actual, b_status becomes 1, then readidx is assigned the new writeidx, and EOK=0 is returned. General actual<free is explicitly raw/non-FIFO; do not claim ordinary append store_circular_area.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Require b_force!=0, one abstract circular_area_state through store_circular_area, and caller-owned initialized input bytes. Ensure preserved input ownership and either unchanged unified state on pre-copy errors or one existential abstract raw-force result resource on success. Public With must not expose data_buffer/readidx/writeidx/status/physical/operations.
spec_hint: Use a small record/predicate such as forced_circular_area_state/store_forced_circular_area in this case_lib to package capacity plus raw mixed physical bytes while existentially hiding pointers/index/operations. CircularAreaForceWriteResult should relate the pre FIFO, requested input and exact raw post. Keep memcpy contracts exact. A recovery relation for cases where the resulting representation is genuinely full may be included, but no unconditional raw-to-store bridge.
preferred_hidden_properties: General force success returns raw ownership because equal indices/status=1 asserts full in the unified invariant even when the truncated actual write did not fill the ring. The spec must preserve this implementation risk explicitly.
forbidden_patterns: Do not retain the old int[3] model; do not alter real CRTOS executable tokens; do not return store_circular_area unconditionally on force success; do not expose implementation witnesses in public With; do not weaken memcpy to emp/shape-only; do not use QCP_demos_human.
